summary: Prioritize emotional conflict and moral dilemmas in storytelling.
Ensure the hook in the first 30 seconds addresses the central betrayal.
Keep total video length under 10 minutes to maintain high retention.
Use titles that promise a clear 'lesson learned' or 'justice served' outcome.
Avoid overly long, complex Hindi titles that clutter the thumbnail space.
Focus on relatable family dynamics that trigger immediate audience empathy.
Maintain a steady narrative pace to prevent retention drops during exposition.
Include a clear 'call to action' only after the emotional climax.
